reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the kinetic phase selection concept from P13/P8 with the corrosion mechanism from P4/P5, applying it to a new Mg-containing lightweight HEA system (AlBeMgTiCu/Si) that P1 only computationally predicted as metastable. It proposes a specific kinetic threshold linking intermetallic morphology to oxidation/corrosion resistance, an integration not stated in any single passage, and extends the idea to a material and regime not previously studied.
